with a as (select coalesce(rc.display_name,'(Sin)') cat, count(*) n_hab, sum(rm.beds_per_room) n_pax from rooms rm join room_categories rc on rc.id=rm.category_id where rm.company_id='7808b663-735b-46ab-b4ae-80ec4c14c61a' group by 1)
select 'Nº Habitaciones' as row, cat as col, n_hab::float8 v from a
union all select 'Nº Pax', cat, n_pax::float8 from a order by 1, 2
